claim: Patchline ships verified learned heuristics whose acceptance never weakens the underlying soundness guarantee. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the verified learned heuristics claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make verified-learned-heuristics-gate`.
